_doc: Music scoring signatures for Grok native AV — live-action + animation + shared
_source: Claude OPUS cinematic music scoring deep research v1 + Grok Pass 7 animated music research
_engine: Grok Imagine / Aurora — synchronized audio in-pass (dialogue, lip-sync, SFX, ambient, music)
_chain_rule: Continue from the attached previous audio tail + final video frame for perfect score evolution and harmonic continuity.
_originality_lock: Fully original homage-style composition only — no copyrighted melodies, arrangements, or recognizable themes.
_architecture: Three tiers: live_action (Claude craft + gap-fills), animation (Grok Pass 7), shared (Hisaishi bridges both). music_* governs score/melody/harmony; sound_* governs foley/ambience/SFX. Independent and combinable — any music_* with any sound_* and any style_*.
_scope_rule: music_* chain_prompts reference: score, motif, swell, melody, harmony, orchestration, theme, leitmotif. Never reference: foley, ambience, SFX, spatial audio, environmental sound (those belong to sound_*).
